assignment.title: Episode 20 mission: Integrated everyday mission
assignment.instructions:
LISTEN: Hear twice and answer: What is the new start time?

READ: Read for purpose and detail. Answer: What must someone do by Thursday?

SPEAK: Confirm the new time, ask which bus, and request repetition. Try once unaided, then improve one detail.

WRITE: Confirm event, corrected time, route, and one item. Check word order, forms, and purpose.

TRANSFER: Change to Sunday and another bus; update all details.

RETURN: State purpose, time, place, action.
assignment.model:
Speaking: Jag ringer om språkcaféet. Menar du halv elva? Vilken buss ska jag ta? Kan du upprepa?
Writing: Jag kommer till språkcaféet på lördag. Det börjar halv elva. Jag tar buss sju och tar med en penna.

takeaways: Use: Igår missade jag bussen, men idag åker jag tidigare.
